clips.title: The story
paras: Ragefire Chasm threatens Orgrimmar from beneath its streets, where troggs have broken into the tunnels. The fiery caverns also shelter a cult whose plans reach beyond Durotar.

Ragefire troggs have surged into the volcanic tunnels beneath Orgrimmar. They pushed up from deep fissures and now threaten the city's foundations. Magatha Grimtotem, a tauren, tried to make peace with them, but the troggs answered with violence. Their tunnels run below the stone streets and fortified towers, leaving Orgrimmar at risk if the creatures keep digging upward.
